headline: Luanda Projected to Surpass Lagos as African Megacity Demographics Shift
summary: Demographic projections indicate Angola's capital Luanda is positioned to overtake Lagos, Nigeria, in urban population metrics as its total population moves past 20 million residents.
why: Rapid urban demographic growth in African megacities drives long-term municipal infrastructure development and consumer market expansion.

impacts.name: Angola
impacts.why: Substantial urban demographic growth attracts foreign long-term urban development and telecom investment.
